owner_decisions.D1: Linux cgroup memory replacement accepted for design only; no enforcement approval.
owner_decisions.D2: 130.1-second CPU and 170/171/180-second wall values accepted only as unverified targets.
owner_decisions.D3: Evaluate simpler artifact controls before custom FUSE; alternatives were considered, but the proposed replacement metric is not approved.
owner_decisions.D4: Qualification allowance is planning-only and not execution authority.
owner_decisions.D5: Authenticated non-network host/guest control is required; design remains unqualified.

qualification_plan.q06_candidate_scope: Q06 nested accounting subtree; action-on-detection only, not a hard bound
qualification_plan.session_wall_origin: Q0 immediately before the single VM-start request
qualification_plan.combined_artifact_metric_note: Sum of distinct guest project-allocation and host NTFS quota-usage metrics; not one physical or logical-byte measure.

findings: Handshake and replay protocol are specified but untested.
COM/pipe exclusivity and VM identity binding are unqualified; key non-cloning/non-reuse is an assumption.
Host watchdog/controller failure has no autonomous recovery or guaranteed VM-Off deadline.
Q06-local and continuous aggregate CPU accounting scopes and Q0/Tcase lifecycle are clarified.
No hard 130.1-second or 240-second CPU bound is established.
The 170/171/180-second stages and 600-second aggregate wall ceiling are targets, not guaranteed deadlines.
Guest ext4 allocation and host NTFS quota usage are distinct accounting metrics.
The quota design does not enforce the frozen aggregate 5 MiB logical high-water cap.
Metric replacement, complete path coverage, reserve behavior, and durability remain unapproved or untested.
Frozen/R1 identities, D1-D6 limits, case lifecycle, and budget arithmetic reconcile.
Infrastructure and metric approvals remain absent; no execution was authorized.

preserved_status.original_pilot: NOT SUPPORTED AS A PROTOCOL-COMPLIANT PILOT; not an efficacy result
